cards.text: David has just won back his family from Amalekite raiders (1 Samuel 30:18-19). Now the Philistines are at war with Israel, the nation led by Saul, its king. Pull up a stool, friend.

cards.question: The battle is on Mount Gilboa. How does it go for the men of Israel?

cards.text: The Philistines chase Saul and his sons hard. One of those sons is Jonathan, David's dear friend (1 Samuel 18:1-3).

cards.question: Jonathan, Saul's son, makes it out of the battle alive.

cards.text: Then the battle intensifies against Saul, and the archers wound him critically. He turns to his armor-bearer and says the Philistines will come and torture him.

cards.question: What does wounded Saul ask his armor-bearer to do?

answers.text: Run him through with his sword

cards.question: Saul's armor-bearer refuses to do what Saul asks him to do.

cards.text: This part is heavy, friend. His armor-bearer is terrified and refuses, so Saul takes his own sword and falls on it.
When his armor-bearer sees that Saul is dead, he too falls on his own sword and dies with him.
Saul, his three sons, his armor-bearer and all his men die together that same day. Israelites in the valley and across the Jordan see that the army has fled and that Saul and his sons are dead.

cards.question: The Israelites in the valley and across the Jordan see that the army fled and Saul and his sons are dead. What do they do?

answers.text: Crown a new king right away

cards.question: After the Israelites in the valley and across the Jordan run away, the ___ come and occupy their cities.

cards.text: The next day, the Philistines come to strip the dead. And there on Mount Gilboa, they find Saul and his three sons.

cards.question: The Philistines cut off Saul's head. Then they strip off his ___.

cards.text: Then they send messengers all through the land of the Philistines with the news.

cards.question: The Philistines send messengers to spread the news about Saul. Where do the messengers announce it?

answers.text: In the temples of their idols
In the tents of Israel's army
At the city gate of Gibeah

cards.text: Saul's armor goes into the temple of the Ashtoreths, false goddesses. But the Philistines aren't done with his body.

cards.question: The Philistines hang Saul's body on the wall of ___.

cards.text: Word reaches the people of Jabesh-gilead. Saul once rescued that town from the Ammonites (1 Samuel 11:1-11).

cards.question: When the men of valor of Jabesh-gilead hear what the Philistines did to Saul, what do they do?

answers.text: Bring the bodies back to Jabesh
Send word to David in Ziklag
Gather an army to attack Gath

cards.text: They journey all night to get the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth-shan. When they arrive at Jabesh, they burn the bodies there.

cards.question: After burning the bodies of Saul and his sons, what do the men of Jabesh do with the bones?

answers.text: Bury them under a tree in Jabesh
Carry them back to Mount Gilboa

cards.question: After burying the bones under the tamarisk tree, the men of Jabesh fast for seven days.
